description: AURA Signal Mapping: Maps raw behavioral triggers to standardized system Signal IDs

camouflage:naive.description: Naive persona framing, including false innocence, victim, or hobbyist disguises

alibi:academic.description: Academic, educational, or student research alibis used as justification

alibi:general.description: Altruistic or ethical justifications for unauthorized activities

camouflage:role.description: Professional or authorized role impersonation (e.g., IT staff, auditor, pentester)

camouflage:domestic.description: Personal, domestic, or financial distress narratives used as cover

behavior:urgency.description: Artificial urgency, coercion, or high-pressure communication tactics

exploit:actionable.description: Requests for functional exploits, weaponized assets, or executable payloads

evasion:control.description: Techniques aimed at bypassing security controls, compliance, or access restrictions

recon:targeted.description: Targeted intelligence gathering, infrastructure fixation, or automated OSINT scraping

extortion:leverage.description: Extortion tactics using psychological leverage, reputational threats, or coercion assets

deception:fact.description: Fabrication of material facts, high-fidelity deception, or fake identity generation

target:highvalue.description: Fixation on high-value corporate targets or display of unjustified domain expertise

fin:suspicious.description: Suspicious financial requests, direct fraud indicators, or payment manipulation alibis
